status: declared before any VAE reconstruction forward pass
question: How do posterior sampling and the released latent coordinate scale affect one fixed image's encode-decode round trip?

input.source: Previously retained SD1.4 pilot output; same-model generated watercolor image
input.preprocessing: RGB float32 divided by 255, BCHW, then 2*x-1; preserve original size without cropping or resampling

cases.decoder_input: scaling_factor * posterior.mode(); deliberate omission of inverse scaling

budget.repeat_condition: Primary succeeded, full child wall <= 120 seconds and process lifetime peak RSS <= 8 GiB
budget.repeat_scope: Repeat the complete same six-case command in a new result and run-record directory
budget.note: Budgets are predeclared limits. Existing SD timing does not isolate VAE cost; no reconstruction runtime estimate is claimed.

outputs: Original input identity and preprocessed input array
Posterior mean, clipped logvar, standard deviation and all decoder-input latents
Raw decoder arrays and unclipped RGB arrays for every case
All clipped and quantized PNGs, with complete contact sheet
Raw/clipped RGB MSE and RMS, range and out-of-range fraction, clipping RMS
Posterior reparameterization and latent scaling round-trip residuals
All array/file hashes, source and dependency identities, per-stage timing, peak RSS
Run recorder argv, complete logs, wall time, termination and exit state
interpretation: Report this fixed image's encoder-decoder round-trip error; the encoder is not proven to find the optimal latent for this decoder.
Posterior mode equals latent mean for this diagonal Gaussian, while decoding the mean generally differs from averaging decoded samples.
Three seeds illustrate posterior perturbations for one input; they do not establish natural-image dataset performance.
Squared pixel error to a [0,1] target cannot increase after clipping; raw values and clipping effects are therefore reported together.
No U-Net, text encoder, diffusion sampling, retraining or model quality ranking is part of this experiment.
